content:
olivia: quick heads-up — ran nvprof + perfetto on the flash-attn variant after the perf regression. dynamic batching + kv-cache shows big KV write spikes once batch_size > 8. uploading traces now.

samir: can you paste the nvprof kernel summary you saw?

olivia: nvprof top kernels (snippet):
```
Kernel                          Time(ms)  Calls
---------------------------     -------   -----
flash_attn_forward_v2            12.4      120
kv_write_commit                  47.2      15   <-- huge
kv_read_prefetch                 3.1       120
fused_attention_dispatch         1.9       120
```
The kv_write_commit spikes coincide with batchbound crossings in the trace.

perf-bot: nsys trace uploaded: https://perf-storage.example/trace/1932400123.nsys, perfetto link: https://perfetto.example/trace/1932400123

kevin: interesting — might be write coalescing / bank-conflict storm when multiple microbatches flush their KV backfills concurrently. which GPU was this on?

olivia: ran on A100-80GB. ida also repro'd on A100-40GB but not on A10G. timeline shows SM occupancy drop during the kv_write windows and a long serialize on L2.

ida: sounds like bandwidth saturation + serialization. I suspect our prefetch/write ordering differs on those SKUs. also saw that runtime picked the "flash-fused-kv" variant even for seq_len 256 — threshold math in selector looks suspect.

samir: that could explain it — fused variant optimizes for long seqs but triggers heavy writebacks for short sequences under certain batch shapes. do you have the runtime log line where selector chose the variant?

olivia: yes — runtime log: `selected_variant=flash-fused-kv, seq_len=256, batch_bound_est=16, selected_by=heuristic_v1` — I think the batch_bound_est calc uses average_seq not p90, so bursts push it over the internal watermark.

kevin: plan: 1) add a guard to kernel_selector so fused-kv only chosen if seq_len >= hard_min_for_fused (e.g., 512). 2) add a small stagger to kv writebacks to avoid synchronized flushes across microbatches. I'll prototype quick patch and run nvprof sweep. @olivia can you rerun perfetto after I land patch?

olivia: will re-capture perfetto + flamegraph after patch. uploaded the current flamegraph to the perf trace link.

ida: i'll run a batch sweep (batch_size 1..32) across A100 and A10G and collect kv_write ms and overall p95. will post csv.

samir: also add a test that simulates microbatch overlap so we don't regress this again. maybe add a small unit test in runtime/batching that exercises stagger behaviour.

olivia: created issue ENG-RUNTIME-3454 with logs and trace links. assigning to kevin + ida. thanks! :thumbsup:

kevin: on it. will post results in this thread once nvprof/ perfetto runs finish.

perf-bot: background job complete, nvprof summary attached to issue ENG-RUNTIME-3454.

olivia: great — closing loop once we have numbers.
